title: Training Sheet: The Pricing Assist Responsiveness Adjustment (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Training Sheet — Responsiveness Adjustment

*Host Support training, Roamhaven Listings.*

## The rule

The responsiveness adjustment is a Pricing Assist adjustment, a fraction of the all-in night, worked out on the day of the request. It reads the message response rate shown by the most recent Superhost assessment recorded on the host account (the Host Accounts record of the host who owns the listing):

| Response rate shown by the most recent Superhost assessment | Responsiveness adjustment |
|---|---|
| at least 98.00% | 0.01 |
| below 90.00% | -0.02 (a reduction) |
| at least 90.00% and below 98.00% | none |
| no Superhost assessment on the host account | none |

## Questions and answers

**Response rate exactly 98.00%?**
At least 98.00%: 0.01.

**Response rate 97.99%?**
Between the two figures: no responsiveness adjustment.

**Response rate exactly 90.00%?**
Not below 90.00%: no responsiveness adjustment.

**Response rate 89.50%?**
Below 90.00%: a reduction of 0.02.

**Which assessment is read when the account has several?**
The most recent Superhost assessment.
